resources.string: Cur stiagh date Hijri dy gheddyn Arafah, An-Nahr as ny laa Tashreeq
Cur stiagh date Hijri dy akin Arafah, An-Nahr as ny laayn Tashreeq
Cur stiagh date Hijri ry-hoi. Bleean veih 1300 gys 1600, mhee veih 1 gys 12, laa veih 1 gys 30.

Cur stiagh dagh date Hijri (ny cum y date t\'ayn nish) dy gheddyn dy kiart ny laa Hajj jeh\'n vleïn echey: Laa Arafah (9 Dhul-Hijjah), Laa An-Nahr (10 Dhul-Hijjah) as Laa Tashreeq (11, 12 as 13 Dhul-Hijjah), position co-cheangailt rish dty date.
Yn coloin smoo: seose ayns Arafah veih lurg y ghrian gys y ghrian, as jannoo mooar dy ghraih, takbir as tahlil. Dy dooyrt y Phadeyr: "Ta\'n Hajj Arafah."
Eid al-Adha: cloie Jamarat al-Aqabah lesh seihnt cloan, cur y oural, scarrey ny trim, as jean Tawaf al-Ifadah as Sai.
Fockle laa as laa ta cur coontey diu jeh\'n rite t\'er ny h-oik \'sy traa echey \'sy laa Hajj (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah)

Sunnah y laa t\'ayn: gow ihram stiagh, gow stiagh gys Mina as gow yn oie shen, as gow y Talbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk", as gow padjer ayns shen glennit gyn co-chosney.
Stone ny tree Jamarat lurg mean y laa: y beg, eisht y mean, eisht y mooar, seihnt pebbles gagh unney tra v\'ad gra takbir, goaill arrane erreish da\'n beg as y mean.

Reayrt cloie ny tree Jamarat lurg mean y laa myr ec y laa shen. As quoi-erbee ta aggindagh dy ghra, t’eh er n’eiyrt magh ass Mina roish y ghrian; quoi-erbee ta stay, t\'eh caghlaa yn oie as cloie er y treeoo laa.
Stone ny tree Jamarat lurg y ghrian, as eisht cloie yn Hajj lesh y Tawaf s\'fadagh tra t\'ou goll ass Makkah. Gow Allah rish dty Hajj.

Taggyrt glen son Hajj as Umrah: mraane as rieughid, ny seihlltyn riteyn, y mawaqit, ny riteyn step by step lesh nyn ghliock as cre dy ghra ec gagh stashoon, ny bannaghyn ihram, as ny h-artysyn. Taght y rannagh taitnyssagh.
